title: Bigin 'Make an API call' in Make returns the marketing homepage instead of JSON
symptoms: The response is the Bigin marketing site
cause: The module's URL is relative to https://www.zohoapis.com/bigin. A path without /v2, or one that repeats /bigin, resolves to the marketing site and still returns 200.
fix: Start every path with /v2/. Pass the fields query parameter on list calls, and check info.more_records because pages cap at 200.
affected: Make Bigin by Zoho app version 2, July 2026
